name: HYDRA-UMC-SYNTHETIC-DATA-GEN
notes: Real v0 procedural 2D scene generation, stdlib-only BMP rasterization, and real YOLO/COCO annotation export (`generate` subcommand), verified end to end incl. visual inspection of a real rendered image. Honestly 2D placeholder shapes, not the photorealistic 3D rendering through HYDRA-UMC-TWIN's own engine the README describes - that engine doesn't exist yet (TWIN is itself still scaffolding). TFRecord export and real 3D rendering are future work.
